messages:
sara: Quick sync  scheduled canary dry-run for a new route tonight during the change window. Need pin/rollback plan and short smoke tests.

sara: Window 23:30-00:45 UTC. Flag: `route-llm-v4` (boolean). Ramp plan: 1% -> 10% -> 40% over ~45m with checks after each step.

vikram: ack. what are the exact success/failure signals we want at each holdpoint? :mag_right:

sara: keep it focused: median latency (p50) & tail (p99), user-facing error rate, and token-cost delta. Trigger if p99 >15% above baseline for 10m, or error-rate >0.2% for 5m, or token-cost per request increases >30% sustained for 15m.

lee: fallback target should be `v2.4.0-hotfix` for the route pin. Confirm?

sara: yes pin to `v2.4.0-hotfix` is our immediate fallback. deploy-bot, record emergency pin and a soft-drain procedure.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary dry-run for 1757009999. Cohort slices: [1%, 10%, 40%]. Emergency fallback: pin route to `v2.4.0-hotfix` and soft-drain new v4 instances. Manual ack required for full rollback. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Rollback & pin checklist:
```
1) Toggle feature `route-llm-v4` -> false
2) Update route-map: set route default -> `v2.4.0-hotfix`
3) Run `deployctl drain --tag=llm-v4-temp --grace=60s`
4) Run smoke-runner against golden prompts, watch SLOs for 15m
5) If stable after 15m, escalate to postmortem + release note update
```

ashley: ops will be on-call during the window in #eng-oncall. If a holdpoint fires, do we stop and wait 10m or rollback immediately?

sara: Stop and investigate for 10m. If clear remediation (eg config tweak) we can hold, otherwise pin and drain. We only auto-pause the rollout; auto-rollback is disabled.

vikram: telemetry hooks  I'll add dashboard tiles and quick queries for: token_cost_per_request p95/p99, request_error_ratio, p50/p99 latency per model node, and inflight queue length. Alerts: page at 3x baseline error-rate or p99 breach.

lee: adding small smoke curl to run after each ramp step. we should run it from the canary runner: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.dev/gen" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model_route":"route-llm-v4","prompt":"smoke test short: ping","max_tokens":8}' | jq -r .status
```

lee: QA will run a 20-example golden prompt set after the 10% step. If any regression >3 mismatches, flag for rollback.

sara: good call. small release blurb (for GH release notes): "Dry-run: v4 routing canary. Incremental traffic tests; rollback safepoint to v2.4.0-hotfix if issues." Lee will paste.

deploy-bot: updated automation: on holdpoint -> pause rollout, post a message to `@eng-releases` and `@eng-oncall`, and attach a link to the rollback checklist. Auto-rollback remains off; only manual `ack rollback` triggers pin.

vikram: one more thing  can we capture a quick token-sample histogram during the test? put a tag `canary=llm-v4` so we can slice in dashboards.

sara: yes tag will be applied. Also preflight at 23:15 UTC to validate config and run smoke curl once.

ashley: I'll standby in #eng-oncall at 23:20 UTC and will escalate if alarms hit.

lee: will draft the short release note and paste to the release PR after dry-run.

sara: thanks everyone. last step: deploy-bot, schedule the cron for the window and annotate the thread with the run id.

deploy-bot: scheduled: run_id=rb-1757009999-canary, cron=23:30 UTC. Notifications set. Good luck team. :rocket:
